offering_description.value: Designs, sources and sells aftermarket replacement parts for cars and trucks, sold under its own brands and to retailers. Customers are auto parts retailers, warehouse distributors and repair shops, delivered from distribution centers.

primary_products.value: brake parts; engine and fuel system parts; electrical and sensor parts; HVAC parts; body hardware; heavy-duty truck parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: auto parts retailers, warehouse distributors, heavy-duty truck parts distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: replacement parts sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets parts made by contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and distributors; distributor: warehouses and ships parts to auto parts retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada, Mexico, with some sales in Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: brake, engine, electrical, fuel, HVAC and heavy-duty truck parts sold through the same channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national and regional retail chains; distributors / dealers: warehouse distributors and heavy-duty parts distributors; online: online retailers and e-commerce sites selling its parts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions-related parts face EPA and CARB rules, product safety and import rules apply
